analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($122.26) vs SMA5/20/50 ($124.65/$129.36/$130.96) — Below short-term MAs, below mid-term MAs
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($137.46/$153.16) — Below long-term MAs, maintaining bearish trend strength
· 52-week position (15.7%) + Current price near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.5→43.3) — Attempting slight rebound after entering oversold, failed to recover to neutral
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0601→-0.7046) — Worsening in negative territory, signaling strengthening bearish trend
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $120.48) — Approaching lower band, bandwidth (13.74%) is moderate
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($119.41) — Close to 5-day low ($117.89), above Pivot S1 ($113.80)
· Swing resistance ($125.25) — Below 5-day high ($132.41), potential for short-term rebound on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Not Higher Low, Lower High maintained) — Bearish pattern continues
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.87x) — Below 5-day average, reduced conviction in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — RSI entering oversold and 5-day low support confirmation are positive, but MACD weakness and lower 5-day high indicate insufficient trend reversal signals; maintaining 'watch' stance
